sprint: Museum Caption Freeze Fix — the Root Cause of the Reported 'Center Pane Still Freezes' Bug
task: a fresh investigation after the user reported 'the studio center screen froze issue is still as it is,' despite the extensive history of prior freeze fixes (ThumbnailEngine clobber, Selection Action Strip repaint, root-Studio cache-busting, text-resize freeze). A real Playwright reproduction (seeding the real themes/MuseumGallery.vtheme package with a synthetic moveable:true/editable:true override on its own museum-caption Layer Pack entry, exactly matching a real Theme Author's own authored permission) confirmed the model correctly records a fresh position/size override on every drag/resize tick, and SlideRenderer.render() is confirmed (via a monkey-patched instrumentation, 19 real calls) to receive that fresh override on every single redraw -- yet the rendered pixels and the object's own bbox in getSceneElements() never moved. Root cause: renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawText(layer,anchor,rect,s) early-returns to a completely separate function, _drawMuseumCaption(t,anchor,s), the instant a Layer's text.source is 'museumCaption' -- BEFORE ov=_layerOverride(s,layer.id) is ever read on the line directly below. _drawMuseumCaption itself never accepted an override parameter and never read _layerOverride internally either, so a moveable/editable Museum Caption Layer (type:'text', so resize handles ARE shown for it, per _supportsResize) had its Story-Author drag/resize overrides silently, completely ignored at render time -- a direct Guardrails (Creator Rule #2) violation predating every one of the prior freeze investigations, since none of them had reason to look inside this one theme-specific declarative text-source branch. Fixed by threading `layer` through to _drawMuseumCaption and teaching it the same position-as-translation and size-as-wrap-width semantics _layerDrawText's own generic content path already applies (reusing the shared _wrapText helper) -- absent any override, maxWidth stays Infinity and the exact original string/whitespace is used untouched (never routed through _wrapText at all), byte-identical to before this fix. A real, subtle regression was caught via a git-stash SHA-256 canvas-pixel-hash A/B before shipping: an early version of the fix routed the natural (no-override) string through _wrapText even at maxWidth=Infinity, which still re-joins whitespace-split words with a single space each -- silently collapsing the metaLine's own deliberate '   |   ' (3-space) visual separator to a single space for EVERY existing Museum Caption render, a real confirmed pixel regression; fixed by only ever calling _wrapText once a genuine size override exists, keeping the raw untouched string (exact original whitespace) for the natural case. Verified via a direct SceneEngine.setPosition/.setSize proof (reposition genuinely moves the rendered center to the target; widening past what already fits correctly causes no new line-wrap, matching Builder's own resize semantics; narrowing forces real multi-line re-wrapping; the no-override case is confirmed pixel-for-pixel byte-identical against the real, unmodified themes/MuseumGallery.vtheme file via SHA-256 hash) AND a full real-mouse-driven end-to-end drag through the actual UI (Object Strip selection, a genuine page.mouse drag from a body point verified via distance-to-every-resize-handle math to be safely clear of all 8 handles' hit-test slop, confirming the model records position-only [never triggering an accidental resize] and the object visibly, correctly moves ~400 model units on the live canvas, screenshotted). Both tools/world-builder/verify/goldenBuild.js and tools/world-builder-v2/verify/goldenBuild.js pass unchanged (30/30 each), confirming zero impact on the Build/Publish/Import pipeline.
